verdict_note: @pte/ui had no test infrastructure; vitest was added (node environment, react-dom/server renderToStaticMarkup, no DOM library) and 250 tests in 11 files were written for every Phase 6 primitive. All pass. No production bug found. Tests were proven non-vacuous by 6 mutants applied to a copy of the sources in the scratchpad (never the repo). The 6 StatCard consumer files and DataTable.tsx are byte-identical to the recorded hashes. No git command was run; the StatCard 'regression' is a characterisation of the post-change output for the legacy props (there is no pre-change copy to diff against; integrity of the consumers is covered by hash + app typechecks).

QUAL-001.change: TrendBarChart.tsx passes accessibilityLayer={false} to <BarChart>; TrendLineChart.tsx passes it to <LineChart>. Verified in recharts 3.8.1: CartesianChart.js defaults accessibilityLayer to true and es6/container/RootSurface.js sets tabIndex=0 and role='application' on the chart <svg> only when it is true (undefined when false, unless otherAttributes carries explicit tabIndex/role, which the components never pass); RechartsWrapper.js adds no tabIndex/role. JSDoc on both chart components explains why (tooltip is pointer-only; the sr-only table is the keyboard/AT path).
